title: Finite sums of integral ideal pushforwards have the summand filtration
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with integral source [def-pc-integral-scheme], $r\in\mathbb N$, and $I\ne0$ a coherent ideal sheaf [pqf-def-coherent] represented by $Z.\mathrm{IdealSheafData}$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Then the module $i_*(I^{\oplus r})$ [def-pc-module-pullback] has a finite coherent integral-ideal filtration [def-weil-pbc-coherent-integral-filtration]. The assertion includes $r=0$, with the empty filtration.

proof.text: Induct on r. The zero case is the empty filtration, and the successor case is the split-sum induction step.

theorem coherentIntegralFiltration_ideal_sum
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (r : ℕ) (I : Z.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥)
    (hI : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules) :
    HasCoherentIntegralFiltration
      ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules))
